# SchemeDB — NFL Tactical Scheme & All-22 Playbook Visualizer

> SchemeDB is a high-fidelity football analytics and tactical engineering workstation containing 20 NFL scheme systems (10 Offensive, 10 Defensive), 80 hand-authored plays with Catmull-Rom spline trajectory waypoints, 0.0s–1.2s disguise mesh window telemetry, and 6 coaching lineage trees spanning 20 NFL head coaches and patriarchs.

## Overview & Architecture

- **Mathematical Engine**: 22-player waypoint interpolation using Catmull-Rom cubic splines with exact arc-length parameterization for realistic deceleration, plant steps, and break angles.
- **Coordinate System**: Field dimensions are LOS-relative yards where `x` represents cross-field position (`0.0` left sideline to `53.33` right sideline, hashes at `23.36` and `29.97`) and `y` represents depth relative to the Line of Scrimmage (`y < 0` backfield, `y > 0` downfield).
- **Disguise Mesh Window (0.0s – 1.2s)**: The critical pre-snap to early post-snap window where constraint plays mirror primary base runs/passes. Ghost overlays and conflict telemetry quantify defender commitment frames.
- **Play Sequencing Framework**: Every play defines explicit game-plan relationships:
  - `setsUp`: Plays unlocked or amplified by establishing this call.
  - `playsOff`: Complementary plays whose visual picture this call mimics.
  - `tell`: The singular visual cue distinguishing this play from its partner.

## Web Application Deep Links & Navigation

- **Film Room Visualizer**: `https://schemedb.com/?tab=visualizer`
- **Scheme Catalog**: `https://schemedb.com/?tab=directory`
- **Coaching Trees**: `https://schemedb.com/?tab=trees`
- **Sequence Matrix**: `https://schemedb.com/?tab=sequence-map`
- **Direct Play Links**: `https://schemedb.com/?play={play-id}` (e.g., `https://schemedb.com/?play=outside-zone`)
- **Direct Scheme Links**: `https://schemedb.com/?scheme={scheme-id}` (e.g., `https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shanahan-wide-zone`)

## Offensive Scheme Families (10 Systems / 40 Plays)

### Kyle Shanahan's Wide Zone Family (`shanahan-wide-zone`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Kyle Shanahan (San Francisco 49ers)
- **Philosophy**: The premier modern NFL offensive system built on horizontal stretch sequencing. The base Outside Zone run and its three constraint counters (Play-Action Deep Over, Naked Bootleg, and Jet Motion) present an identical visual picture to the defense for the first ~1.2 seconds, forcing defenders into impossible run-pass conflicts.
- **Plays**:
  - [Outside Zone Left](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shanahan-wide-zone&play=outside-zone) (`outside-zone`): Stretch the defense horizontally from sideline to sideline to create wide running lanes and force linebackers into overpursuit.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker (Playside Flow LB). Tell cue: Base run action with full offensive line reach-and-seal flow and RB pressing the playside tackle landmark.
  - [Wide Zone Play-Action Deep Over](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shanahan-wide-zone&play=play-action-over) (`play-action-over`): Exploit second-level defenders overplaying the run by throwing deep intermediate passes into the vacated zone behind them.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker (Playside Flow LB). Tell cue: Backside WR (Z) cuts across the formation behind linebackers on a deep Over route instead of stalking downfield.
  - [Wide Zone Naked Bootleg](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shanahan-wide-zone&play=naked-bootleg) (`naked-bootleg`): Punish aggressive backside defensive ends and pursuit defenders who crash down the line against wide zone runs.. Key conflict: Backside Defensive End (Contain) & Strong Safety. Tell cue: QB pulls the ball out of the mesh and rolls right away from the offensive line flow, while TE releases into the backside flat.
  - [Jet Motion Outside Zone Left](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shanahan-wide-zone&play=jet-motion-oz) (`jet-motion-oz`): Force the defense to shift gap fits and rotate secondary coverage laterally before/at snap, creating perimeter numbers advantages.. Key conflict: Overhang / Strong Safety & Playside Cornerback. Tell cue: Z-receiver runs full-speed jet motion across the formation before/at snap, creating a 2nd mesh point in the backfield.

### Klint Kubiak's Motion & Split-Zone / Leak Family (`kubiak-split-zone`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Klint Kubiak (Las Vegas Raiders)
- **Philosophy**: A masterclass in modern Shanahan-Kubiak sequencing. By marrying heavy 12-personnel condensed formations, pre-snap glide/orbit motion, and under-center split-zone run mechanics, Kubiak presents an identical visual picture before unleashing devastating intermediate Dagger shots, explosive backside Y-Leaks, and rapid perimeter tosses.
- **Plays**:
  - [Split Zone (Slice)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=kubiak-split-zone&play=split-zone-slice) (`split-zone-slice`): Use split-flow action to punish aggressive horizontal pursuit and create a massive cutback alley behind a sealing H-back.. Key conflict: Backside Defensive End (WDE) & Mike Linebacker. Tell cue: Base foundation call: H-Back slices across the formation to kick out the backside DE on true zone run.
  - [Play-Action Dagger Shot](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=kubiak-split-zone&play=pa-dagger-shot) (`pa-dagger-shot`): Exploit aggressive linebacker run fits by pairing a hard split-zone play-action fake with a clear-out post and intermediate Dagger (dig) route.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker & Single-High Free Safety (FS). Tell cue: Backside X stems vertical into intermediate Dagger instead of stalk blocking; QB pulls ball at t=1.3s.
  - [Boot Throwback Y-Leak](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=kubiak-split-zone&play=boot-throwback-leak) (`boot-throwback-leak`): Devastate over-aggressive defenses with the signature Y-Leak constraint: faking a slice block before leaking the H-back vertically into vacated boundary space.. Key conflict: Backside Defensive End (WDE) & Boundary Cornerback (LCB). Tell cue: H-Back bluffs the kick-out block on backside DE and leaks vertically untouched down the sideline.
  - [Orbit Motion Perimeter Toss](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=kubiak-split-zone&play=orbit-motion-toss) (`orbit-motion-toss`): Outflank aggressive defenses by combining pre-snap orbit motion and a rapid perimeter toss with multiple pulling lead blockers.. Key conflict: Strong Safety (SS) & Strongside Defensive End (SDE). Tell cue: Z runs pre-snap orbit motion behind the QB to distort secondary fits before snap.

### Andy Reid's Spread-RPO & Mesh Passing Family (`reid-spread-rpo`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Andy Reid (Kansas City Chiefs)
- **Philosophy**: The pinnacle of modern hybrid football. Andy Reid synthesizes classic West Coast horizontal passing and timed rhythm with modern spread RPO tags, Mesh shallow crossing rub combinations, misdirection power shovel passes, and perimeter sprintout smash-wheel concepts. Operating out of 11-personnel Gun Trips alignments, Reid stresses second-level conflict defenders with identical pre-snap looks before unleashing lethal horizontal and vertical route combinations.
- **Plays**:
  - [Mesh Shallow Cross](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=reid-spread-rpo&play=mesh-shallow-cross) (`mesh-shallow-cross`): Create impossible natural pick/rub traffic for underneath zone and man defenders while stretching the defense horizontally and vertically with perimeter rail and deep clearout routes.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker & Nickel DB (Underneath Hook/Curl defenders). Tell cue: Base mesh timing with RB releasing on a wide rail route while slot receivers execute underneath shallow cross rub.
  - [Inside Zone RPO Glance](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=reid-spread-rpo&play=rpo-glance-post) (`rpo-glance-post`): Put the backside second-level linebacker in an inescapable run-pass conflict, punishing aggressive run fits with immediate intermediate completions.. Key conflict: Will Linebacker (Backside Run-Fit Conflict Defender). Tell cue: QB reads backside Will linebacker crashing the B-gap and pulls ball for rapid glance release to X.
  - [Power Shovel Option](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=reid-spread-rpo&play=power-shovel-option) (`power-shovel-option`): Create an unstoppable misdirection interior shovel pass that exploits defensive ends widening to defend the quarterback perimeter option and sweep threat.. Key conflict: Strongside Defensive End (SDE) & Mike Linebacker. Tell cue: Offensive guard pulls frontside while QB executes forward shovel option to TE inserting through A-gap.
  - [Sprintout Smash-Wheel](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=reid-spread-rpo&play=sprintout-smash-wheel) (`sprintout-smash-wheel`): Outflank perimeter pass rush with a moving pocket sprintout while executing a smash-wheel concept that punishes squatting Cover 2 cornerbacks.. Key conflict: Right Cornerback (RCB) & Strong Safety (SS). Tell cue: QB takes half-roll sprintout launch point to perimeter while outside receiver runs high-speed smash-wheel.

### Sean McVay's Condensed Duo & Play-Action Attack (`mcvay-duo-playaction`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Sean McVay (Los Angeles Rams)
- **Philosophy**: Sean McVay's championship offensive system engineered around condensed 11-personnel formations with tight receiver splits. By pairing physical 'Power without a puller' Duo double-teams with identical play-action 3-level Sail floods, explosive deep crossing over-routes, and rapid Glance RPOs, McVay keeps defensive front sevens in permanent schematic conflict.
- **Plays**:
  - [11P Duo Lead Inside Power Run](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcvay-duo-playaction&play=mcvay-duo-lead-run) (`mcvay-duo-lead-run`): Punish light nickel boxes with vertical double-teams ("Duo"), creating massive interior movement and establishing the physical run picture that unlocks play-action shot plays.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker (Playside Interior LB). Tell cue: Offensive line vertical-punch double teams climbing to Mike linebacker; no pulling guard, RB presses interior A-gap mesh.
  - [Play-Action Sail 3-Level Flood](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcvay-duo-playaction&play=mcvay-pa-sail-flood) (`mcvay-pa-sail-flood`): Create a 3-level vertical flood (deep clearout, 12-yard intermediate out, 2-yard flat) off under-center Duo play-action to overload Cover 3 and Cover 4 zone defenders.. Key conflict: Nickel Apex Defender / Strong Safety (Curl-Flat Defender). Tell cue: Slot receiver H stems vertical before breaking 90 degrees outward on a 12-yard Sail route while QB pulls the ball out of Duo mesh.
  - [Play-Action Deep Over / Crosser](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcvay-duo-playaction&play=mcvay-pa-deep-crosser) (`mcvay-pa-deep-crosser`): Attack the vulnerable intermediate middle-of-the-field void (18-22 yards) against two-high and single-high defenses by pairing a deep post clearout with a crossing over-route.. Key conflict: Weak Safety (FS in Quarters) & Mike Linebacker. Tell cue: Backside X receiver takes a deep inside release crossing behind second-level linebackers at 18-20 yards depth instead of digging or stalk blocking.
  - [Glance RPO with Orbit Return Motion](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcvay-duo-playaction&play=mcvay-glance-rpo-orbit) (`mcvay-glance-rpo-orbit`): Punish aggressive run-stopping linebackers by reading the apex/Will defender on a post-snap RPO, pairing interior Duo power with a rapid Glance slant route.. Key conflict: Will Linebacker (Weakside Second-Level Conflict Defender). Tell cue: Pre-snap orbit motion across the backfield paired with post-snap mesh read; QB keeps eyes glued on the conflict apex linebacker.

### Mike McDaniel's Speed Cheat-Motion & Space Attack (`mcdaniel-cheat-motion`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Mike McDaniel (Los Angeles Chargers)
- **Philosophy**: Mike McDaniel's revolutionary speed-in-space scheme that weaponizes pre-snap 'Cheat Motion' (sprint-speed motion at the snap). By giving explosive playmakers a running start to crack edge defenders on perimeter tosses, feigning cracks on devastating sideline wheel shots, punishing overpursuit with inside zone Wham traps, and running pistol speed options in the red zone, McDaniel creates mathematical dilemmas for any defense.
- **Plays**:
  - [Cheat Motion Crack Toss Perimeter Stretch](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcdaniel-cheat-motion&play=mcdaniel-cheat-motion-toss) (`mcdaniel-cheat-motion-toss`): Weaponize extreme pre-snap speed ("Cheat Motion") to create an unmatchable angle on the perimeter, cracking the edge defender and pulling offensive linemen for an explosive outside toss.. Key conflict: SAM Linebacker / Strongside Edge Defender. Tell cue: Receiver in cheat motion snaps inside to deliver crack block on edge/LB while RB takes immediate wide toss track.
  - [Cheat Motion Wheel Shot (Speed Release)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcdaniel-cheat-motion&play=mcdaniel-cheat-motion-wheel) (`mcdaniel-cheat-motion-wheel`): Punish defenses over-committing to McDaniel’s Cheat Motion perimeter crack toss by bluffing the crack block and releasing the fastest receiver on an uncontested vertical wheel route.. Key conflict: Field Cornerback (RCB) & Strong Safety. Tell cue: Motion receiver bluffs crack block for 0.4s then explosive vertical burst along the boundary on the wheel route.
  - [Inside Zone Wham with Cheat Decoy](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcdaniel-cheat-motion&play=mcdaniel-inside-zone-wham) (`mcdaniel-inside-zone-wham`): Exploit defensive lateral overpursuit with an inside zone Wham trap, using pre-snap speed motion as eye candy while trapping the 3-tech DT from the blindside.. Key conflict: 3-Technique Defensive Tackle & Mike Linebacker. Tell cue: FB/H-back cuts back against the grain on a wham trap block on the 3T DT instead of leading to the perimeter.
  - [Pistol Speed Option Pitch & Space Read](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=mcdaniel-cheat-motion&play=mcdaniel-pistol-option-pitch) (`mcdaniel-pistol-option-pitch`): Create a 2-on-1 space dilemma on the perimeter edge in short-yardage / red-zone situations using speed option mechanics from pistol.. Key conflict: Strongside Defensive End (Option Read Key). Tell cue: QB attacks outside shoulder of unblocked DE on a fast lateral option track with RB in parallel pitch relationship.

### Kevin Stefanski's Multi-TE Gap & Under-Center Play-Action Family (`stefanski-multi-te-gap`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Kevin Stefanski (Atlanta Falcons)
- **Philosophy**: Master of condensed multi-tight end structures, violent pin-and-pull gap schemes, GT counter lead concepts, and deep play-action seam/bootleg shots. Kevin Stefanski builds an overpowering offensive machine founded on angle blocking, devastating complementary under-center fakes, and high-efficiency vertical passing off run action.
- **Plays**:
  - [13P Pin & Pull Sweep](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=stefanski-multi-te-gap&play=stefanski-pin-pull-sweep) (`stefanski-pin-pull-sweep`): Create overwhelming perimeter gap leverage against single-high defenses by pinning frontside defensive linemen inside and pulling interior linemen as lead escorts.. Key conflict: Strong Safety (SS) & Mike Linebacker (MIKE). Tell cue: Center & RG immediately pull playside while RT & Y down-block (pin).
  - [Play-Action Seam Shot](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=stefanski-multi-te-gap&play=stefanski-pa-seam-shot) (`stefanski-pa-seam-shot`): Punish aggressive single-high run defenses by faking the pin-and-pull sweep and launching a vertical seam strike to the primary tight end behind suckered linebackers and safeties.. Key conflict: Free Safety (FS) & Strong Safety (SS). Tell cue: Y releases vertically after flash down-block; QB sets deep in pocket instead of handing off.
  - [Naked Bootleg Slide](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=stefanski-multi-te-gap&play=stefanski-naked-boot-slide) (`stefanski-naked-boot-slide`): Exploit defenses over-pursuing Stefanski's heavy pin-and-pull run flow by rolling the quarterback naked to the opposite boundary with a 3-level flood/slide concept.. Key conflict: Weakside Defensive End (WDE) & Will Linebacker (WILL). Tell cue: QB keeps ball around backside edge naked; backside TE (U) releases into weakside flat.
  - [Counter Gap GT Lead](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=stefanski-multi-te-gap&play=stefanski-counter-gap-lead) (`stefanski-counter-gap-lead`): Gasoline the defense with heavy gap-scheme power: down blocks create an unmovable wall, while a pulling guard kicks out the edge and a lead tight end pancakes the linebacker.. Key conflict: Strongside Defensive End (SDE) & Mike Linebacker (MIKE). Tell cue: Backside LG and F pull across formation on GT/GF counter paths; RB takes counter jab step before cutting back.

### Shane Steichen's QB Mesh & Spread RPO System (`steichen-qb-mesh-rpo`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Shane Steichen (Indianapolis Colts)
- **Philosophy**: A dual-threat quarterback maximization system rooted in Andy Reid's West Coast principles with modern college Spread DNA. Shane Steichen pairs zone-read power runs with RPO bubble/glance perimeter reads, Mesh shallow crosses that create natural rubs against man coverage, and vertical switch releases that exploit deep zone voids. The system demands a mobile signal-caller who threatens the edge on every designed run, compressing defensive end responsibilities into an impossible choice.
- **Plays**:
  - [Gun QB Power Read](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=steichen-qb-mesh-rpo&play=steichen-qb-power-read) (`steichen-qb-power-read`): Put the frontside defensive end in an impossible spatial dilemma: if he widens to stop the perimeter sweep, the dual-threat QB powers downhill behind a pulling guard.. Key conflict: Strongside Defensive End (SDE) & Mike Linebacker (MIKE). Tell cue: Backside RG pulls playside while RB crosses on horizontal sweep path; QB reads frontside DE.
  - [Mesh Rail / Wheel](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=steichen-qb-mesh-rpo&play=steichen-mesh-rail-wheel) (`steichen-mesh-rail-wheel`): Exploit man-to-man coverage by pairing a tight shallow-cross Mesh rub with an explosive running back Rail/Wheel route along the boundary.. Key conflict: Will Linebacker (WILL) & Free Safety (FS). Tell cue: RB free-releases on boundary rail/wheel route while slot receivers set tight crossing rub.
  - [Inside Zone + Bubble Screen RPO](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=steichen-qb-mesh-rpo&play=steichen-zone-bubble-rpo) (`steichen-zone-bubble-rpo`): Conflict the apex/overhang defender with a simultaneous inside zone run and perimeter bubble screen, taking whatever the defense concedes with ruthless efficiency.. Key conflict: Nickel DB (Overhang Conflict Key). Tell cue: Playside WRs immediately stalk block on snap while slot WR flares on bubble arc; QB catches and throws at mesh.
  - [4-Verticals Switch Shot](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=steichen-qb-mesh-rpo&play=steichen-verticals-switch) (`steichen-verticals-switch`): Destroy Two-High Quarters coverage by crossing the release paths of the #1 and #2 receivers on deep vertical tracks, triggering coverage miscommunication and blown assignments.. Key conflict: Strong Safety (SS) & Right Cornerback (RCB). Tell cue: Slot H and outside Z cross stems at 6 yards on vertical release instead of standard screen/blocking releases.

### Matt LaFleur's Illusion of Complexity & Deep Shot Family (`lafleur-illusion-packers`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Matt LaFleur (Green Bay Packers)
- **Philosophy**: A masterclass in schematic deception and visual illusion. Matt LaFleur marries condensed 12-personnel and dual-back Pony sets with identical under-center wide-zone run mechanics to lull defenses into overpursuing, before unlocking catastrophic deep Cross-Country Posts, Dagger intermediate concepts, and perimeter constraint wheels.
- **Plays**:
  - [Wide Zone Cutback (Illusion Flow)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=lafleur-illusion-packers&play=lafleur-wide-zone-cutback) (`lafleur-wide-zone-cutback`): Create wide horizontal stretch with 12-personnel under-center flow to force linebackers to overpursue and open a devastating backside cutback lane.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker (Playside Flow Linebacker). Tell cue: Full offensive line lateral bucket steps with under-center RB taking the handoff and pressing the tackle landmark rather than QB keeping.
  - [PA Cross-Country Deep Post](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=lafleur-illusion-packers&play=lafleur-cross-country-post) (`lafleur-cross-country-post`): Present an identical wide-zone run look to pull linebackers downhill and manipulate the single-high Free Safety with an intermediate crosser, opening an explosive deep post across the entire field.. Key conflict: Free Safety (Deep Middle Cover 3 Safety). Tell cue: Tight end (TE1) releasing into the secondary after a 0.8-second delay rather than staying attached to the perimeter reach block.
  - [Pony Package Screen-Wheel Constraint](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=lafleur-illusion-packers&play=lafleur-pony-screen-wheel) (`lafleur-pony-screen-wheel`): Exploit defenses overreacting to quick perimeter screen calls by pairing dual-back Pony personnel with a fake screen left and a devastating rail wheel right.. Key conflict: Apex Nickel / Strong Safety (Boundary Flat & Deep Half Defenders). Tell cue: Shotgun Pony split-back alignment with QB pump-faking to the swing before resetting his feet to the opposite boundary.
  - [PA Dagger Seam-Dig Concept](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=lafleur-illusion-packers&play=lafleur-pa-dagger-dig) (`lafleur-pa-dagger-dig`): Attack 2-high / Cover 4 Quarters defenses using a two-man vertical stretch (Seam Pin + 15-yard Dig) over an underneath shallow drag crosser.. Key conflict: Middle Linebacker & Quarters Free Safety. Tell cue: Tight bunch alignment with TE1 bursting vertically up the seam rather than crossing behind the line of scrimmage.

### Nick Sirianni's Power RPO & Brotherly Shove System (`sirianni-power-rpo`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Nick Sirianni (Philadelphia Eagles)
- **Philosophy**: A physical, identity-driven offense built on gap power football paired with perimeter RPO access. Nick Sirianni's Eagles combine power duo runs that rely on vertical double-teams, RPO glance and slant reads that punish aggressive linebackers, boundary isolation for elite wide receivers, and the most famous short-yardage play in the NFL — the Brotherly Shove quarterback sneak.
- **Plays**:
  - [Inside Power Duo (Double Teams)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=sirianni-power-rpo&play=sirianni-power-duo-inside) (`sirianni-power-duo-inside`): Impose pure physical will at the line of scrimmage with interior Duo double teams, blowing defensive tackles off the ball and creating a heavy north-south running lane.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker (Interior Gap Fitter). Tell cue: Gun 3x1 formation with offensive line firing straight ahead on vertical power angles without pulling guards.
  - [Backside Glance ISO RPO](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=sirianni-power-rpo&play=sirianni-rpo-glance-iso) (`sirianni-rpo-glance-iso`): Put the backside Will linebacker in an impossible run-pass conflict: if he steps up to stop the interior Duo run, punish him immediately with a rapid Glance route to the isolated X receiver.. Key conflict: Will Linebacker (Backside Conflict / Run-Fit LB). Tell cue: Quarterback keeping eyes locked on the backside linebacker during the mesh rather than carrying out a naked keeper.
  - [Slot Fade Out Isolation](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=sirianni-power-rpo&play=sirianni-slot-fade-out) (`sirianni-slot-fade-out`): Create an isolated 1-on-1 matchup on the perimeter for an elite route-runner from the slot, using an underneath out route to pin the outside corner and clear the sideline.. Key conflict: Star / Nickel Defensive Back (Inside Leverage Slot Defender). Tell cue: Straight dropback by the QB from 2x2 formation with no mesh handoff action.
  - [Brotherly Shove (Tush Push)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=sirianni-power-rpo&play=sirianni-qb-sneak-push) (`sirianni-qb-sneak-push`): Execute the mathematically and physically near-unstoppable short-yardage quarterback sneak by combining low offensive line pad leverage with dual backfield pushers.. Key conflict: Nose Tackles & Mike Linebacker (Interior Goal-Line Squeeze). Tell cue: Ultra-tight wedge splits along the offensive line with dual pushers aligned directly behind the quarterback’s hips.

### Ben Johnson's Counter Deception & Gadget Offense (`johnson-counter-deception`)
- **Architect / Head Coach**: Ben Johnson (Detroit Lions)
- **Philosophy**: A brilliantly layered offensive system built on counter run misdirection, pre-snap orbit motion, and seamless play-action packaging. Ben Johnson weaponizes dual-pull counters, hook-ladder mesh rubs, TE throwback leaks off counter PA, and orbit-driven RB screen convoys to create a complete deception ecosystem where every play looks identical from the defensive perspective until it's too late.
- **Plays**:
  - [11P Gun Counter Trey Lead (Detroit Back-Side Deception)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=johnson-counter-deception&play=johnson-counter-trey-lead) (`johnson-counter-trey-lead`): Use pre-snap counter step and dual pulling guard deception to freeze linebackers and create an explosive B-gap crease.. Key conflict: Mike Linebacker (Playside LB). Tell cue: Both guards pull simultaneously in same direction; RB counter false step with QB reverse pivot before handoff.
  - [Play-Action TE Throwback Leak (Counter Shell PA)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=johnson-counter-deception&play=johnson-pa-te-throwback) (`johnson-pa-te-throwback`): Use counter run look PA to move WILL linebacker inside, then throw back to leaking TE in the vacated flat.. Key conflict: Will Linebacker (Weakside LB). Tell cue: Same counter step from RB and reverse pivot from QB — but TE releases instead of blocking at 0.8s.
  - [Hook-Ladder Mesh with TE Stack (Quick Deception Screen)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=johnson-counter-deception&play=johnson-hook-ladder-mesh) (`johnson-hook-ladder-mesh`): Exploit man-coverage rules with a 2-man mesh rub that legally frees the RB against press-man Nickel coverage on 3rd down.. Key conflict: Will Linebacker (Man Coverage on RB). Tell cue: TE aligned tight to line at tackle depth; RB initial release toward TE before sharp angle to mesh.
  - [Orbit Reverse Screen with Late Wheel Release (Detroit Gadget)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=johnson-counter-deception&play=johnson-orbit-reverse-screen) (`johnson-orbit-reverse-screen`): Use orbit motion and deep QB look-off to pull all defenders deep and inside, then dump to RB with three escort blockers in the flat.. Key conflict: Strong Safety (Deep TE Wheel Responsibility). Tell cue: Orbit motion pre-snap with TE crossing behind QB; three linemen releasing early is the screen key.

## Defensive Scheme Families (10 Systems / 40 Plays)

### Robert Saleh's 4-3 Wide-9 & Cover 3 Match (`saleh-43-wide9`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Robert Saleh (San Francisco 49ers / NY Jets)
- **Philosophy**: A masterclass in modern defensive front geometry and disciplined coverage matching. Built around aggressive Wide-9 defensive end splits and penetrating 3-techniques that generate elite 4-man pressure, complemented by pattern-matching Cover 3 Rip/Liz, split-field Cover 6 brackets, and timed A-gap cross-dog blitzes.
- **Plays**:
  - [Cover 3 Match (Rip/Liz)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=saleh-43-wide9&play=saleh-cover3-match) (`saleh-cover3-match`): Generate organic 4-man pass rush via Wide-9 speed angles while suffocating passing concepts with pattern-matching Cover 3 Rip/Liz rules.. Key conflict: WDE (Wide-9 speed rusher) & SAM (Apex match defender on slot seam). Tell cue: Base single-high alignment with SS rolling into the 8-man box/overhang at snap
  - [Cover 6 Split-Field Bracket](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=saleh-43-wide9&play=saleh-cover6-bracket) (`saleh-cover6-bracket`): Counter 3x1 Trips formations and flood concepts that typically stress single-high Cover 3 by deploying split-field Quarters to the field and Cover 2 to the boundary.. Key conflict: RCB (Field Corner) & SS (Field Safety) in Quarters bracket technique. Tell cue: Field safety stays deep in Quarters alignment instead of buzzing down into the box at snap
  - [4-3 Cross-Dog Fire Zone 3](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=saleh-43-wide9&play=saleh-cross-dog-fire3) (`saleh-cross-dog-fire3`): Manufacture guaranteed interior penetration against standard 5-man/6-man slide pass protections using a synchronized A-gap cross-dog blitz.. Key conflict: WILL (Delayed A-gap blitzer) & MIKE (Point-of-attack pick blitzer). Tell cue: Mike & Will sprint downhill at snap to cross interior gaps instead of reading backfield run flow
  - [NASCAR Package Cover 1 Robber](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=saleh-43-wide9&play=saleh-nascar-cover1-robber) (`saleh-nascar-cover1-robber`): Deploy maximum pass rush speed (4 defensive ends) on 3rd-and-long while setting a Cover 1 Robber trap to jump intermediate crossing and dig routes.. Key conflict: SS (Robber / Lurk defender) & WDE (Speed edge rusher). Tell cue: Pass-rush front widens into NASCAR splits and SS drops to low robber hole rather than deep 1/3

### Mike Macdonald's Hybrid Disguise & Sim Pressures (`macdonald-hybrid-disguise`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Mike Macdonald (Baltimore Ravens / Seattle Seahawks)
- **Philosophy**: The cutting edge of NFL defensive design. Built on pre-snap ambiguity, Amoeba and Double-A mug presentations, 4-man simulated pressures (Creepers) that drop interior linemen into passing windows, post-snap safety spins into corner traps, and lethal 6-man Cover 0 peel blitzes that force quarterbacks into impossible post-snap calculations.
- **Plays**:
  - [Double-A Mug to Cover 3 Buzz](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=macdonald-hybrid-disguise&play=macdonald-double-mug-buzz) (`macdonald-double-mug-buzz`): Manufacture pre-snap protection chaos and force inaccurate hot throws by showing a 6-man Cover 0 blitz, then dropping 7 defenders into a suffocating Cover 3 Buzz shell.. Key conflict: WILL (A-gap bail linebacker) & SS (Downhill Buzz safety). Tell cue: Base mug look where both mugged linebackers bail into hook zones at snap while SS buzzes down
  - [4-Man Creeper Fire Zone (Sim Blitz)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=macdonald-hybrid-disguise&play=macdonald-creeper-overload) (`macdonald-creeper-overload`): Manufacture an unblocked free rusher (Nickel DB) while keeping 7 coverage defenders on the field by dropping interior DT into the quick hot-throw window.. Key conflict: NICKEL (Unblocked creeper blitzer) & 3T (Interior simulated dropper). Tell cue: Nickel DB triggers on a blitz trajectory while 3-Tech drops into the shallow throwing lane
  - [Single-High to Cover 6 Trap](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=macdonald-hybrid-disguise&play=macdonald-split-field-trap) (`macdonald-split-field-trap`): Bait opposing quarterbacks into throwing standard Cover 3 beaters (out routes and sail concepts) by feigning a single-high middle-of-field-closed shell before spinning into a deadly Cover 6 corner trap.. Key conflict: LCB (Trap Corner) & SS (Disguised deep half safety). Tell cue: Free safety spins from middle-of-field-closed to deep half post-snap, triggering corner trap
  - [Amoeba Overload House Blitz (Cover 0 Peel)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=macdonald-hybrid-disguise&play=macdonald-amoeba-cover0-peel) (`macdonald-amoeba-cover0-peel`): Deploy maximum chaos and bring a 6-man overload house blitz on money downs, using the Peel technique on the edge to eliminate the QB’s hot checkdown.. Key conflict: WDE (Peel defender on RB) & MIKE (Unblocked interior blitzer). Tell cue: All mugged rushers explode forward with no underneath droppers, edge peeling on RB

### Brian Flores' Psycho Front & Cover 0 Pressure (`belichick-flores-psycho`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Brian Flores (Minnesota Vikings / New England Patriots)
- **Philosophy**: An extreme binary pressure system rooted in Bill Belichick chameleon football and weaponized by Brian Flores into the NFL’s most terrifying pre-snap presentation. By crowding the line of scrimmage with 6 to 7 mugged rushers in the Psycho Front, the defense creates identical pre-snap chaos before either sending an unblockable 7-man Cover 0 house blitz, bluffing and dropping 8 into muddy coverage traps, executing interior A-gap cross-dog twists, or bracketing the offense’s #1 star wide receiver.
- **Plays**:
  - [Psycho 7-Man All-Out House Blitz (Cover 0)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=belichick-flores-psycho&play=cover0-all-out-house) (`cover0-all-out-house`): Overwhelm 5-man and 6-man pass protections with an unblockable 7-man zero-safety house blitz, forcing an immediate sub-2.0s throw or violent sack.. Key conflict: LURKER (Unblocked interior house rusher) & LCB (Zero-safety press lock). Tell cue: All 7 defenders at the line of scrimmage rush full-tilt, leaving cornerbacks in pure zero-safety press man.
  - [Psycho Bluff Drop-8 Lurk](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=belichick-flores-psycho&play=drop8-psycho-lurk) (`drop8-psycho-lurk`): Exploit the quarterback’s conditioned fear of the Cover 0 house blitz by bluffing 7 rushers and bailing 4 into the exact hot throwing windows.. Key conflict: LURKER (Floating middle robber/lurker). Tell cue: Four mugged rushers bail backward at snap into intermediate zone cushions while 3 rushers push pocket.
  - [Psycho 6-Man Cross-Dog Fire Hot](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=belichick-flores-psycho&play=cross-dog-fire-hot) (`cross-dog-fire-hot`): Defeat slide protections and 6-man half-slide schemes by manufacturing instant interior penetration via an A-gap cross-dog twist while protecting the deep field with Hot coverage.. Key conflict: LB_A2 (Looping A-gap crosser) & LB_A1 (Penetrating pick rusher). Tell cue: Inside linebackers cross through opposite A-gaps on a delayed twist stunt behind edge contain.
  - [Psycho Chameleon Bracket (Double #1 Star)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=belichick-flores-psycho&play=bracket-doubles-star) (`bracket-doubles-star`): Eliminate the opponent’s primary star wide receiver using a Belichick-style bracket double-team disguised out of Flores’ signature 7-man psycho mug front.. Key conflict: LCB & LURKER (Bracket tandem on #1 Star WR). Tell cue: Boundary corner plays outside leverage while safety brackets inside hip of star receiver in high-low double.

### Vic Fangio's Two-High Shell & Quarters Matching (`fangio-two-high-shell`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Vic Fangio (Philadelphia Eagles / Denver Broncos)
- **Philosophy**: The defensive philosophy that reshaped modern NFL game-planning. Built on a static, impenetrable two-high safety shell pre-snap that disguises split-field Cover 6 (Quarter-Quarter-Half), Palms Match Quarters (2-Read), Drop-8 simulated creeper pressures, and lethal boundary corner traps. Paired with light-box 5-1-5 Penny fronts that suffocate explosive passing concepts while matching underneath crossing routes.
- **Plays**:
  - [Cover 6 (Quarter-Quarter-Half Split Safety)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=fangio-two-high-shell&play=cover6-quarter-quarter-half) (`cover6-quarter-quarter-half`): Present an ambiguous 2-high shell pre-snap, then split the field into Quarters to the passing strength and Cover 2 to the boundary to suffocate vertical seams and intermediate outs.. Key conflict: Field Safety (FS) matching #2 seam and Boundary CB (LCB) playing cloud squat on the flat. Tell cue: Base split-safety structure: Field safety matches slot seam in Quarters while Boundary safety rolls to deep half.
  - [Penny 5-1-5 Match Quarters (Palms / 2-Read)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=fangio-two-high-shell&play=penny-match-quarters) (`penny-match-quarters`): Deploy symmetrical 4-deep match (Palms / 2-Read) from the identical 2-high pre-snap shell to jump quick out routes and rob crossing patterns.. Key conflict: STAR (Nickel) reading #2 out-break and BS (Boundary Safety) driving top-down on #1. Tell cue: Both safeties trigger top-down at 10-12 yards matching #2 receivers vertical while Star DB plays palms flat.
  - [Tite Creeper Drop-8 Coverage Trap](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=fangio-two-high-shell&play=tite-creeper-drop8) (`tite-creeper-drop8`): Simulate a heavy 5-man Penny rush pre-snap, then drop both outside linebackers into underneath passing lanes to eliminate quick-game hot reads in Drop-8 coverage.. Key conflict: LOLB & ROLB executing bluff-and-drop into hook-curl passing lanes. Tell cue: Both edge rushers bluff penetration then bail into intermediate hook-curl lanes as defense drops 8.
  - [Cover 8 Boundary Corner Trap](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=fangio-two-high-shell&play=cover8-boundary-trap) (`cover8-boundary-trap`): Bait the quarterback into throwing a boundary intermediate out-route against what appears to be soft Quarters cushion, only for the boundary corner to trap the route while the safety caps deep.. Key conflict: LCB (Boundary Corner) timing the trap break and BS (Boundary Safety) capping deep vertical routes. Tell cue: Boundary corner squats and traps out-route underneath while Boundary safety rotates over top.

### Jesse Minter's Amoeba Front & Simulated Creepers (`minter-amoeba-creeper`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Jesse Minter (Baltimore Ravens / Los Angeles Chargers)
- **Philosophy**: A masterclass in pre-snap psychological warfare and simulated pressure architectures. Jesse Minter combines standing 6-up Amoeba fronts, slot corner simulated blitzes (Creepers) dropping athletic defensive ends, disguised Cover 1 Lurk rotations that bait quarterbacks into underneath robber traps, and lethal Double-A mug Cover 0 peel blitzes that neutralize hot reads.
- **Plays**:
  - [Amoeba Front 5-Man Fire Zone 3](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=minter-amoeba-creeper&play=minter-amoeba-fire-zone3) (`minter-amoeba-fire-zone3`): Use pre-snap Amoeba chaos to dictate offensive pass protections, then bring a timed 5-man A-gap fire pressure while dropping the mugged MIKE directly into the hot slant lane.. Key conflict: WILL (weak A-gap blitzer) & MIKE (Amoeba bail linebacker). Tell cue: Standing 6-up look where 5 rushers fire while MIKE bails to strong hook and SS buzzes down to boundary flat
  - [Nickel Slot Blitz Creeper (Simulated Pressure)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=minter-amoeba-creeper&play=minter-slot-blitz-creeper) (`minter-slot-blitz-creeper`): Manufacture free edge pressure with only a 4-man rush by dropping a defensive end into coverage while sending a lightning-fast slot defensive back.. Key conflict: NICKEL (unblocked slot blitzer) & WDE (creeper flat dropper). Tell cue: Standard 4-down look where SDE spikes inside to pin the RT while Nickel blitzes from the slot and WDE drops into coverage
  - [Amoeba Cover 1 Robber Lurk](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=minter-amoeba-creeper&play=minter-cover1-robber-lurk) (`minter-cover1-robber-lurk`): Show all-out blitz pre-snap to force quick man-beating throws (Mesh/Slants), then drop a linebacker into the low hole to bait and intercept the quarterback.. Key conflict: MIKE (Lurk / Rat-in-the-hole robber linebacker). Tell cue: Pre-snap sugar front rotates into Cover 1 Man-Free with MIKE squatting as a middle-hole robber on crossers
  - [Double-A Mug Cover 0 Peel Blitz](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=minter-amoeba-creeper&play=minter-double-mug-peel) (`minter-double-mug-peel`): Create instant interior pressure with a Double-A gap blitz while utilizing a "peel" technique to automatically erase the offense’s built-in hot check to the running back.. Key conflict: WILL (A-gap mug blitzer with peel responsibility) & MIKE (interior blitzer). Tell cue: Both A-gap linebackers mug pre-snap, with WILL peeling to cover the flaring RB while MIKE rushes the A-gap and corners play press man

### DeMeco Ryans' Wide-9 Attack & Match Coverage (`ryans-wide9-attack`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: DeMeco Ryans (Houston Texans)
- **Philosophy**: An aggressive, downhill defensive system engineered around pure physical dominance and geometric leverage. Features extreme Wide-9 defensive end alignments and Tackle-Wrap stunt games that crush pass protections with 4 rushers, backed by split-field Cover 2 Palms (2-Read) cloud traps, Cover 1 Low-Hole mug looks, and field-overload 5-man fire zones.
- **Plays**:
  - [Wide-9 Under Front Tackle-Wrap Stunt (T-E)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=ryans-wide9-attack&play=ryans-wide9-under-tackle-wrap) (`ryans-wide9-under-tackle-wrap`): Exploit the Wide-9 alignment by forcing offensive tackles into elongated kick-slides, then executing a Tackle-End (T-E) wrap stunt to create an unblocked interior rush lane for the defensive end.. Key conflict: SDE (looping edge rusher) & 3T (interior spike tackle). Tell cue: Wide-9 DE takes an exaggerated outside step before looping sharply inside behind the interior 3-technique spike
  - [Split-Safety Palms (2-Read) Match](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=ryans-wide9-attack&play=ryans-cover2-palms-read) (`ryans-cover2-palms-read`): Obliterate standard Smash and quick-out concepts by using split-field 2-Read (Palms) matching, enabling the cornerback to trap underneath out routes while the safety caps deep corner routes.. Key conflict: LCB (Palms flat trap corner) & SS (over-the-top corner cap safety). Tell cue: Two-high shell where the cornerback reads the #2 slot receiver and aggressively jumps the out-route while safety carries #1 deep
  - [Cover 1 Hole with Linebacker A-Gap Mug](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=ryans-wide9-attack&play=ryans-cover1-hole-mug) (`ryans-cover1-hole-mug`): Threaten A-gap pressure to force quick slant/in routes, then drop the mugged linebacker into the low hole to bracket underneath passes while the 4-man Wide-9 front collapses the pocket.. Key conflict: MIKE (A-gap mug low-hole robber) & 3T (interior penetrator). Tell cue: MIKE mugs the A-gap pre-snap then immediately drops 5 yards into the low hole while corners press and safeties roll into single-high robber
  - [5-Man Overload Edge Fire Zone](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=ryans-wide9-attack&play=ryans-overload-edge-fire) (`ryans-overload-edge-fire`): Overload the field side of the pass protection with a 5-man fire zone blitz, creating an unblocked perimeter rusher while dropping the boundary defensive end into coverage.. Key conflict: NICKEL (unblocked overload blitzer) & WDE (boundary flat dropper). Tell cue: Field-side overload pressure with SDE slanting inside to clear the edge for Nickel DB while boundary DE drops into coverage

### Chris Shula's Match Quarters & Penny Front Shell (`shula-match-quarters`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Chris Shula (Los Angeles Rams)
- **Philosophy**: A Fangio-lineage two-high quarters system refined for the modern spread era. Chris Shula employs light Tite (4i-0-4i) and Penny (5-1-5) fronts to maintain interior gap integrity with fewer bodies in the box, while presenting a perpetual two-safety shell that disguises Cover 6, Cover 8, and split-field quarters match calls. Creeper blitzes — defenders who simulate pressure but drop into coverage — are the signature deception weapon that renders pre-snap hot-read systems unreliable.
- **Plays**:
  - [Tite Front B-Gap Pinch with Match Quarters](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shula-match-quarters&play=shula-tite-b-gap-pinch) (`shula-tite-b-gap-pinch`): Suffocate inside zone and Duo run concepts with a 3-man Tite front (404 alignment) by pinching the B-gaps, spilling the ball carrier into the waiting arms of unblocked edge defenders and downhill safeties.. Key conflict: 4iL (B-gap pinch tackle) & BS (downhill alley-fitting boundary safety). Tell cue: 3-4 Tite front where both 4i interior linemen slant hard into the B-gaps spilling run action to perimeter OLBs and downhill safeties
  - [Penny 5-1-5 Bracket Coverage vs Condensed Bunch](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shula-match-quarters&play=shula-penny-bracket-bunch) (`shula-penny-bracket-bunch`): Eliminate natural pick and rub routes from condensed bunch sets by employing a 3-over-2 Triangle Bracket match coverage while retaining a disciplined 4-man Penny rush.. Key conflict: STAR (inside bracket DB) & FS (top cap safety). Tell cue: Penny 5-1-5 front with STAR, corner, and safety forming a tight triangle bracket over the condensed bunch to exchange routes in-and-out
  - [Split-Field Cover 8 (Quarter-Quarter-Half)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shula-match-quarters&play=shula-cover8-field-quarter) (`shula-cover8-field-quarter`): Exploit tendencies against two-high shells by splitting the field coverage: playing Quarters match to the multi-receiver field side and a hard Cover 2 trap to the boundary to intercept quick out-routes.. Key conflict: LCB (Boundary trap corner) & BS (Boundary deep half safety). Tell cue: Two-high pre-snap shell where boundary corner squats in hard flat while boundary safety rolls over top into deep half
  - [Boundary Creeper with Drop-7 Quarter Coverage Shell](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=shula-match-quarters&play=shula-boundary-creeper-drop7) (`shula-boundary-creeper-drop7`): Drop 7 defenders into multi-layered zone coverage by disguising a pass rusher as a creeper, then rushing only 3 linemen while flooding all throwing windows.. Key conflict: Left OLB Creeper (Pre-snap Rush Alignment, Post-snap Drop). Tell cue: LOLB walks up to line in edge rush stance before snap — this is the creeper tell; if he drops, expect a 3-man rush with 7 in coverage.

### Steve Spagnuolo Exotic Blitz & Sim Pressures (`spagnuolo-exotic-blitz`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Steve Spagnuolo (Kansas City Chiefs)
- **Philosophy**: Steve Spagnuolo’s championship-winning defensive scheme: aggressive situational blitzing, boundary corner overloads, 4-man creeper simulated pressures dropping interior linemen, 7-man Cover 0 house heat, and disguised inverted split-safety coverages that break standard quarterback protection reads.
- **Plays**:
  - [Boundary Corner Blitz (Spags Heat)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=spagnuolo-exotic-blitz&play=spagnuolo-corndog-corner-blitz) (`spagnuolo-corndog-corner-blitz`): Manufacture an unblockable blindside corner blitz by manipulating offensive protection with an interior DE stunt while rotating the free safety into the vacated flat.. Key conflict: LCB (Boundary Corner Blitz) & FS (Flat Replacement Safety). Tell cue: LCB shows press alignment with no safety help over the top, then sprints downhill at snap while FS rotates down
  - [Cross-Dog Creeper Sim Pressure](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=spagnuolo-exotic-blitz&play=spagnuolo-cross-creeper-drop) (`spagnuolo-cross-creeper-drop`): Generate unblocked pressure with a 4-man simulated rush by replacing a dropping defensive end with a blitzing linebacker into the offense’s slide protection.. Key conflict: WILL (Creeper Linebacker Rusher) & WDE (Dropping Defensive End). Tell cue: Defensive end steps back into hook drop at snap while off-ball linebacker triggers forward into B-gap
  - [Cover 0 Max All-Out Blitz](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=spagnuolo-exotic-blitz&play=spagnuolo-cover0-max-heat) (`spagnuolo-cover0-max-heat`): Overwhelm 5- and 6-man pass protections on critical 3rd & long downs by sending 7 rushers while playing tight press-man coverage without safety help.. Key conflict: SS (Unblocked 7th Edge Rusher) & FS (Press-Man DB on Slot H). Tell cue: All 7 front defenders rush at snap with DBs pressing at 1 yard depth and no safety retreating deep
  - [Split-Safety Invert Cover 2 Trap](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=spagnuolo-exotic-blitz&play=spagnuolo-split-safety-invert2) (`spagnuolo-split-safety-invert2`): Deceive the quarterback by disguising a two-deep shell as single-high, inverting cornerbacks into deep halves while safeties trigger downhill to trap intermediate seams and out routes.. Key conflict: FS (Downhill Invert Safety) & LCB (Deep-Half Sinking Corner). Tell cue: Corners sprint backwards into deep halves at snap while both safeties drive downhill into underneath curl/flat zones

### Dan Quinn Cover 3 Press-Bail & Under Front (`quinn-cover3-press`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Dan Quinn (Washington Commanders / Seattle Seahawks)
- **Philosophy**: Dan Quinn’s definitive single-high defensive system: physical press-bail cornerback mechanics, 4-3 Under front overloads generating organic 4-man speed rush with the LEO defensive end, Cover 1 Rat-in-the-Hole lurking underneath crossers, and lethal safety Sky fire zone pressures.
- **Plays**:
  - [Cover 3 Press-Bail (Legion Foundation)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=quinn-cover3-press&play=quinn-cover3-press-bail) (`quinn-cover3-press-bail`): Suffocate explosive perimeter passing using physical press-bail cornerback technique and single-high Cover 3 Sky integrity while creating speed pressure with the Wide-9 LEO rusher.. Key conflict: LCB (Press-Bail Corner) & LEO (Wide-9 Speed Edge Rusher). Tell cue: Corners show hard press at line then open hips into side-saddle bail at snap while SS rotates downhill
  - [4-3 Under Front Overload Collapse](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=quinn-cover3-press&play=quinn-under-front-overload) (`quinn-under-front-overload`): Create immediate organic pass-rush disruption using 4-3 Under front alignment angles to generate simultaneous weakside edge speed and strongside interior 3T penetration.. Key conflict: 3T (Penetrating Under DT) & LEO (Weakside Edge Rusher). Tell cue: 1-tech and 3-tech shifted into Under front alignment with LEO stretched out in Wide-9 stance
  - [Cover 1 Rat-in-the-Hole (Lurk Crosser)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=quinn-cover3-press&play=quinn-cover1-rat-in-hole) (`quinn-cover1-rat-in-hole`): Neutralize man-beating Mesh and shallow cross combinations by freeing an underneath defender (The Rat) to lurk in the short intermediate hole while corners play trail technique.. Key conflict: MIKE (Rat-in-the-Hole Lurker) & FS (Deep Post Safety). Tell cue: Middle linebacker mugs A-gap then immediately drops to 6 yards depth as a free-floating lurker while DBs play tight trail man
  - [Safety Sky Fire Zone (3-Deep 2-Under)](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=quinn-cover3-press&play=quinn-safety-sky-fire-zone) (`quinn-safety-sky-fire-zone`): Create a devastating overload edge blitz using Strong Safety from depth on a Sky path while dropping the defensive end to take away the primary hot throw.. Key conflict: SS (Blazing Sky Edge Rusher) & SDE (Dropping Flat Defender). Tell cue: Strong safety creeps towards line before snap and launches outside as SAM crashes inside on tackle

### Todd Bowles Creeper Blitz & Psycho Front (`bowles-creeper-blitz`)
- **Architect / Coordinator**: Todd Bowles (Tampa Bay Buccaneers)
- **Philosophy**: Todd Bowles’ fearsome defensive scheme: Dual A-gap cross-dog interior stunts, boundary corner overloads attacking pass protection slides, Drop-8 Tampa 2 traps with the middle linebacker running the deep pole, and 4-man simulated pressures with edge peel rules.
- **Plays**:
  - [Dual A-Gap Cross-Dog Blitz](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=bowles-creeper-blitz&play=bowles-dual-a-gap-cross-blitz) (`bowles-dual-a-gap-cross-blitz`): Create immediate interior pressure against slide protections by sending a two-man A-gap cross-dog stunt where the first linebacker picks the center and the second loops untouched to the quarterback.. Key conflict: WILL (Looping A-Gap Blitzer) & MIKE (Penetrating Center Picker). Tell cue: Both inside linebackers mug A-gaps at snap, with MIKE charging first and WILL crossing behind his back into opposite gap
  - [Boundary Overload Fire Blitz](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=bowles-creeper-blitz&play=bowles-overload-boundary-fire) (`bowles-overload-boundary-fire`): Exploit half-slide offensive protections toward passing strength by launching an unblockable boundary corner overload while rotating safety coverage into the vacated perimeter void.. Key conflict: LCB (Boundary Corner Blitzer) & LOLB (Pinning Defensive End). Tell cue: Boundary corner creeps close to line with inside tilt while safety aligns at 12 yards on boundary hash preparing to rotate down
  - [Drop-8 Tampa 2 Middle Lurk Trap](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=bowles-creeper-blitz&play=bowles-drop8-tampa2-lurk) (`bowles-drop8-tampa2-lurk`): Create catastrophic quarterback turnovers on long passing downs by bluffing an all-out 7-man blitz and dropping 8 defenders into a suffocating Tampa 2 shell with the middle linebacker running the pole.. Key conflict: MIKE (Deep Middle Pole Runner) & WILL (Intermediate Hook Dropper). Tell cue: 7-man front shows all-out heat, then 4 line-of-scrimmage defenders turn their backs and sprint into coverage zones at the snap
  - [Peel-Zone Simulated Pressure](https://schemedb.com/?scheme=bowles-creeper-blitz&play=bowles-peel-zone-sim-pressure) (`bowles-peel-zone-sim-pressure`): Manufacture an unblocked 4-man simulated pressure from the slot while utilizing peel rules on the edge defender to eliminate the offense’s primary hot checkdown to the running back.. Key conflict: LOLB (Peel Technique Edge Dropper) & NCB (Sim Creeper Blitzer). Tell cue: Edge rusher turns outside immediately to match running back release while slot cornerback sprints downhill on blindside track

## Coaching Lineage Trees (6 Trees / 20 Coaches)

### Shanahan / Kubiak Wide-Zone Tree (`shanahan-kubiak`)
- **Patriarch / Lineage**: Bill Walsh → Mike Shanahan & Gary Kubiak (OFFENSE)
- **Description**: The most influential offensive lineage in modern NFL football. Stemming from Bill Walsh’s West Coast spacing and Mike Shanahan & Gary Kubiak’s legendary Denver Broncos zone-stretch run game. Powers today’s elite offenses led by Kyle Shanahan, Sean McVay, Klint Kubiak, Matt LaFleur, and Mike McDaniel through horizontal stretch runs, play-action deep shots, and disguise meshes identical for the first 1.2 seconds.

### Andy Reid West Coast / Spread RPO Tree (`reid-west-coast`)
- **Patriarch / Lineage**: Bill Walsh → Andy Reid (OFFENSE)
- **Description**: A pillar of modern offensive innovation. Blends classic West Coast rhythm and pass spacing with modern college Spread RPOs, empty/bunch formations, Mesh shallow crosses, jet shovel screens, and 13-personnel tight-end power mismatches.

### Pete Carroll / Robert Saleh Wide-9 & Match Tree (`carroll-saleh-wide9`)
- **Patriarch / Lineage**: Pete Carroll → Robert Saleh (DEFENSE)
- **Description**: A defensive system defined by pure physical dominance and gap-integrity. Employs wide-9 defensive end splits and penetrating 3-techniques to create organic 4-man pressure, backed by disciplined Cover 3 Rip/Liz Match, split-field Cover 6 bracket coverages, and A-gap cross-dog fire zones.

### Mike Macdonald Sim-Pressure & Hybrid Disguise Tree (`macdonald-pressure`)
- **Patriarch / Lineage**: John Harbaugh → Mike Macdonald (DEFENSE)
- **Description**: The cutting edge of NFL defensive design. Built on pre-snap ambiguity, Double-A mug and Amoeba fronts, 4-man Simulated Pressures (Creepers) dropping interior linemen into throwing windows while sending DBs, post-snap split safety spins, and Cover 0 peel blitzes.

### Vic Fangio Two-High Shell & Quarters Tree (`fangio-two-high`)
- **Patriarch / Lineage**: Vic Fangio (DEFENSE)
- **Description**: The defensive system that forced modern offenses to adapt. Shows a static two-high safety shell before the snap to disguise Cover 6, Cover 8, and Quarters match calls, paired with light 3-man Penny fronts to stifle explosive downfield crossers and force long, mistake-prone drives.

### Bill Belichick / Brian Flores Psycho Blitz Tree (`belichick-flores`)
- **Patriarch / Lineage**: Bill Belichick → Brian Flores (DEFENSE)
- **Description**: A radical, highly aggressive defensive philosophy based on extreme binary pressure looks: either sending 6-7 rushers in all-out Cover 0 house blitzes, or bluffing everybody and dropping 8 into muddy coverage zones.

- **Bill Walsh** (`bill-walsh`): Pro Football Hall of Fame Patriarch — San Francisco 49ers (Patriarch). Philosophy: The architect of the West Coast Offense: short, horizontal rhythm passing as a controlled extension of the run game, utilizing spacing, timed drops, a... Key Concepts: West Coast Pass Rhythm, Horizontal Field Stretch, Sprint Right Option, Scripted Openers.
- **Mike Shanahan** (`mike-shanahan`): 2x Super Bowl Champion HC / Wide Zone Pioneer — Denver Broncos / SF 49ers (Patriarch). Philosophy: Pioneered the outside zone stretch run married to Alex Gibbs blocking mechanics, paired with lethal bootleg rollouts and intermediate crossers that to... Key Concepts: Outside Zone Stretch, Naked Bootleg Flood, Cutback Lanework, Play-Action Deep Over.
- **Gary Kubiak** (`gary-kubiak`): Super Bowl 50 Champion HC / Split-Zone Master — Denver Broncos / Houston Texans (Patriarch). Philosophy: Perfected under-center stretch-zone and split-zone slicing action with the fullback/tight end, unleashing devastating throwback bootlegs, deep dagger ... Key Concepts: Split-Zone Slice, Under-Center Play-Action, Tight-End Y-Leak, Condensed Formations.
- **Pete Carroll** (`pete-carroll`): Super Bowl XLVIII Champion HC / Cover 3 Patriarch — Seattle Seahawks (Patriarch). Philosophy: Architect of the "Legion of Boom" single-high Cover 3 match system: physical press-bail corners, disciplined deep-third integrity, and relentless 4-ma... Key Concepts: Cover 3 Match (Rip/Liz), 4-3 Under Front, Wide-9 Speed Edge Rush, Physical Alley Tackling.
- **Bill Belichick** (`bill-belichick`): 6x Super Bowl Champion HC / Defensive Patriarch — New England Patriots (Patriarch). Philosophy: Chameleon defensive football: gameplan-specific odd/even fronts, taking away the opposing offense’s #1 weapon, and Cover 0 psycho overload blitzes.... Key Concepts: Chameleon Gameplanning, Cover 0 House Blitz, Hybrid 3-4 / 4-3 Multiplicity, Bracket / Double #1 Option.
- **Kyle Shanahan** (`kyle-shanahan`): Head Coach, San Francisco 49ers — San Francisco 49ers.
